name: Access restrictions
description: Restricting when and to whom an activity or course section is available: hide it or grey it out until date, group, grade, activity completion, profile or other conditions are met, including conditions from third-party availability plugins.
instructions:
Hidden or greyed out: each unmet condition either hides the item without a trace (its showc/show flag false) or shows it greyed out with a "Not available unless:" note stating what is missing (true). With several unmet conditions, hiding wins: one unmet condition flagged false hides the item completely and none of the other reasons are shown. The note never mentions conditions that are met. Nested subtrees have no flags of their own; only the root flags decide. Choose hidden when students should not know the item exists (content for another group, a surprise reward); choose greyed out when the note guides them (complete this first, opens on that date). Ask the user if their wording leaves the choice unclear.

Examples:
- Opens 1 June, and only for Group A, who should not see it before joining: {"op":"&","c":[{"type":"date","d":">=","t":1748736000},{"type":"group","id":15}],"showc":[true,false]}. A member sees it greyed out until 1 June with the date explained; a non-member never sees it at all.
- In Group A or Group B, and quiz cmid 42 completed: {"op":"&","c":[{"op":"|","c":[{"type":"group","id":15},{"type":"group","id":16}]},{"type":"completion","cm":42,"e":1}],"showc":[true,false]}. A member who has not finished the quiz sees nothing; a non-member who has finished it sees it greyed out naming both groups.

Conditions from optional plugins, usable only when present in enabled_availability_plugins:
- A date relative to the course or the user, such as one week after enrolment (relativedate): {"type":"relativedate","n":1,"d":3,"s":3,"m":0}. n = count; d = unit (0 minutes, 1 hours, 2 days, 3 weeks, 4 months); s = reference point (1 after course start, 2 before course end, 3 after the user's enrolment, 4 after an enrolment method's end date, 5 after course end, 6 before course start, 7 after completing the activity whose cmid is m).
- Completion of the whole current course (coursecompleted): {"type":"coursecompleted","id":"1"}. The id is a string: "1" requires the course completed, "0" not completed.
- Completion of another course section (sectioncompleted): {"type":"sectioncompleted","id":<sectionid>}.
- Membership of a cohort, a site-wide user group (cohort): {"type":"cohort","id":<cohortid>}; 0 or omitted means any cohort.
- Having a role, e.g. teachers only (role): {"type":"role","id":<roleid>,"typeid":0}; typeid 0 = course role, 1 = category role, 2 = global role.
- Being one of specific, named users (user): {"type":"user","userids":[<userid>, ...]}.
- The user's interface language (language): {"type":"language","id":"en"}; "" means any.
- Connecting from certain IP addresses or subnets, e.g. on campus only (ipaddress): {"type":"ipaddress","ipaddresses":"10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.5"}.
- Typing a password to unlock the item (password): {"type":"password","password":"<text>"}.
- Payment through PayPal (paypal): {"type":"paypal","businessemail":"<email>","currency":"USD","cost":10,"itemname":"<text>","itemnumber":"<text>"}.
- Reaching a level in the Level Up XP gamification plugin (xp): {"type":"xp","requiredlvl":<level>,"operator":0}; operator 0 = at least, 1 = exactly that level.
- Holding an item from the Stash game block (stash): {"type":"stash","condition":"has","quantity":1,"objectid":<stash item id>}; condition is "has" or "hasnot".

Also:
- Restrictions stack with the hidden/shown toggle: an activity hidden on the course page stays invisible to students regardless of restrictions.
- A completion condition can only target an activity that has completion tracking enabled.
- Resolve wall-clock dates ("from 1 June") in the user's timezone; get_unix_timestamp converts.
- Prefer & and | with plain conditions; !& and !| rarely match what a user means.
- Look up grouping ids with core_group_get_course_groupings and grade item ids with core_grades_get_gradeitems when needed.
